name: gate_to_600
doc: The Telepod: Crono talks to Lucca, steps on the left pod and is teleported; Marle tries it, her pendant opens the Gate and she vanishes (storyline 0A -> 0C); Crono steps on the left pod again, Lucca sends him through the Gate: 600 A.D., Truce Canyon (loc 071), Crono alone by the Gate.
